clean: Attendance. We know everyone has busy lives, and we don't expect perfect attendance, but the choir only works if people turn up consistently in the last month before a concert. So the rule is that you can miss up to two rehearsals in the four weeks before a performance and still sing in it. If you need to miss more than that, talk to the director, Ireland, as early as possible and we'll try to work something out, for example a catch-up session with your section leader. Please let your section leader know if you'll be absent, even if it's last minute, a quick text is fine. And if you're unwell, especially with anything that affects your voice or might be contagious, stay home. Honestly, we'd much rather you rested than sang through a cold and passed it to the whole alto section.
